## Purpose

Describe the user or engineering problem and why this change is needed.

## Scope

- [ ] Research / diagnostic-only
- [ ] Documentation / developer experience
- [ ] Production-path proposal (requires explicit gate review)

## Verification

List exact commands, test results and environment assumptions.

## Risks and release gates

Describe failure modes, compatibility effects, security implications and any gate status changes. Do not close a gate without its acceptance evidence.

## Rights and secrets

- [ ] No credentials, private keys, seeds, or sensitive personal data added.
- [ ] Any copied/adapted material has known provenance and compatible license terms.
- [ ] Existing third-party notices and file-level license headers are preserved.
